newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Emmis FY97 EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Emmis FY97 EPS view up.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc said Thursday it increased its per-share earnings estimate on Emmis Broadcasting Corp to $1.32 from $1.26 for FY97 which ends February 28. It cited better-than-expected third-quarter results.

--Gruntal also lowered its FY98 EPS estimate to $1.39 from $1.58 and modified its price target to $45 from $47. It cited the dilutive effects of the company's $42.5 million acquisition of radio stations in the St. Louis market from Zimco Radio Group. It expects that acquisition to add to earnings by the end of FY98. Emmis was trading at 35, up 1/4.
